title: Laptop deals UK: best Black Friday laptops under £500, £800 and £1,000
seoTitle: Laptop Deals UK 2026: Best Black Friday Laptops
description: The best UK laptop deals this Black Friday, from a £159.99 Chromebook to MacBook Air M5, with which to buy under £500, £800 and £1,000.
intro:
**The best laptop deal for most people this Black Friday is the Microsoft Surface Laptop with 16GB and 512GB at £799 on Amazon, down from £1,199.** On a tight budget, the Asus Vivobook S16 at £399 (Currys) is the best-value Windows laptop, and the Acer Chromebook 315 at £279.99 (Amazon) is the pick under £300.

- **Best overall:** Microsoft Surface Laptop (16GB, 512GB), £799
- **Best cheap:** Acer Chromebook 315, £279.99
- **Best Mac:** MacBook Air 13-inch M5 (16GB, 512GB), £1,149
- **Best splurge:** MacBook Pro 14-inch M6 (1TB), £1,830.97

Prices were reported on 27 November 2026 in TechRadar's UK Black Friday laptop roundup. Black Friday prices usually run to Cyber Monday (30 November). For more, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

body:
## How to choose a laptop

Start with what it's for, then the budget. Four specs matter far more than the brand name:

- **Memory (RAM):** 8GB is fine for browsing, email and office work. Get 16GB if you keep lots of tabs open, edit photos or plan to keep the laptop four years or more.
- **Storage:** 128GB is tight on Windows once updates pile up. 256GB is a sensible minimum and 512GB is comfortable. Chromebooks need less because most things live online.
- **Chip:** Snapdragon X (Arm) laptops have excellent battery life, but a few older Windows programs, printers and games don't run on them. Check anything you rely on first. Apple's M-series and A18 Pro chips are fast and quiet.
- **Screen:** 13 to 14 inches is the sweet spot for carrying around; 15 to 16 inches is easier on the eyes at a desk.

## Best laptops under £500

For schoolwork, browsing and streaming, a Chromebook is the cheapest thing that works well. The **Acer Chromebook 315** at £279.99 has 8GB and a 15.6-inch screen, which is enough for a family laptop. The £159.99 **Lenovo Chromebook** is fine for a child's first laptop, but 4GB of memory will feel slow with lots of tabs.

If you need Windows (for Microsoft Office desktop apps, specific school software or a printer that only has Windows drivers), the **Asus Vivobook S16** at £399 is the stand-out. It has a 16-inch screen, 256GB and long battery life. The £299 Vivobook 14 is cheaper but its 128GB will fill up.

## Best laptops under £800 and £1,000

The **Surface Laptop at £799** is the pick here: 16GB and 512GB are what you'd normally pay £1,000 or more for. If you're happier on a Mac, the **MacBook Neo at £749** is Apple's cheapest laptop, with 512GB, though only 8GB of memory and a smaller £50 discount.

## Best MacBooks

For most people the **MacBook Air 13-inch M5** is the one to buy, at £1,149 with 16GB and 512GB. It has no fan, so it's silent, and the battery comfortably lasts a working day. The 15-inch version is £1,299. The **MacBook Pro** is only worth it if you edit video or run heavy software; at £1,830.97 the M6 model with 1TB is a fair price, not a dramatic one.

## Gaming laptops

The **Acer Nitro V16** with an RTX 5070 at £1,399.99 is a good mid-range gaming deal. Gaming laptops are heavy and their batteries don't last long away from the plug, so if you mainly play at a desk, a console or desktop gives more for the money. See our [gifts for gamers](/guides/gifts-for-gamers-uk/) guide for cheaper ideas.

## What's a good price?

As a rough guide this Black Friday: a decent 8GB Chromebook under £300, a Windows laptop with 256GB under £400, 16GB and 512GB under £800, and a MacBook Air M5 under £1,150. Be wary of big "was" prices on budget Windows laptops: many are rarely sold at that price, so judge the deal by the spec you get for the money.

## Do you need Prime?

Some Amazon Black Friday prices are for Prime members only (the listing says so), and Prime gets you faster delivery. A [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the rest of Black Friday Week and Christmas delivery; our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) explains how to time it. Looking at tablets instead? See [iPad deals UK](/guides/ipad-deals-uk/).

## Laptop deals FAQs

### What is the best laptop deal this Black Friday?

For most people, the Microsoft Surface Laptop with 16GB and 512GB at £799 on Amazon. On a budget, the Asus Vivobook S16 at £399 at Currys.

### Is a Chromebook or a Windows laptop better for a student?

A Chromebook is cheaper, simpler and faster at the same price, and fine if the school uses Google Classroom or Microsoft 365 online. Choose Windows if a course needs specific desktop software.

### How much RAM do I need in a laptop?

8GB for browsing, email and documents. 16GB if you multitask heavily, edit photos or want the laptop to last.

### Are MacBooks cheaper on Black Friday?

Yes, a little. The MacBook Air M5 is £150 off at Amazon, and Amazon usually has the lowest MacBook prices during big sales. Apple's own store rarely discounts.

### Will laptop prices drop on Cyber Monday?

Usually not much. Most Black Friday laptop prices carry on unchanged to Cyber Monday, 30 November, then some go back up.
